description: A physical location or place which is a subordinate location of a subordinate location.

identifier.description: The unique identifier for this subordinate of a subordinate location, such as a United Nations Location Code (UNLOCODE) or GS1 Global Location Number (GLN).

locationFunctionTypeCode.description: The code specifying the type of subordinate of a subordinate location.

name.description: The name, expressed as text, of this subordinate of a subordinate location.

physicalGeographicalCoordinate.description: Physical geographical coordinate information for this subordinate of a subordinate location.
